parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- This parameter is required only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: SynchronizationJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query the instance ID.

parameters.name: SynchronizationObjects
parameters.description: The modified synchronization objects. The value is a JSON string that supports certain regular expressions. For more information, see [Synchronization object configuration](~~141901~~).
